assessments.reasoning: In Section 2 (Empleo), Pregunta 2 defines work and economic activity around market production ('para la venta'), remunerated service provision ('por remuneración'), or earning money ('por la cual ganó dinero'). Unpaid domestic and care work for one's own household is not included in the definition of economic activity; rather, domestic labor and caregiving are explicitly placed into non-work categories, specifically as a reason for not seeking work (Pregunta 6, option 11: 'LABORES DE CASA/CUIDADO DE MIEMBROS DEL HOGAR') and as an inactive status (Pregunta 7, option 2: '¿Ama de casa / responsable de los quehaceres del hogar?'). Therefore, unpaid domestic and care work is mentioned but treated as inactivity/non-work.
